{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118421/a7034acb288eba6329513112fe2babadb9424db9.png
Optimize game performance and continue to optimize
The last level is polished
Passive skill reconstruction
"The coward" is passive skill changed to the probability of returning fuel
The camera fade time in the state machine is reduced from 5s to 0.1s.
Fix bugs in the drone enabled that cannot be controlled by the mouse
Sleeping in a peace car does not increase libido
Sleeping in a crazy car does not reduce hunger (life limit)
In the ranking, [wealth] is changed to [rent payment], ranking data,
Change from all uploads and downloads to incremental update uploads to reduce download frequency.
The sending condition of the mail is added to the condition of the current safety car, that is to say, some mails are sent to the player only in the limited safety car.
Fix the first level after the completion of the president and click on the cutScene to restart the bug directly to the next level
Adjust previous tasks
Happy Teacher's Day on September 10th
